text.text_excerpt: I stopped in this spot for the first time on NYE with my boyfriend. We were both looking for a good lunch before a few afternoon festivities. I was not disappointed. We started with an order of meat pies and moved on to their equivalent of a meat lovers pizza. Both were served piping hot and fresh! The pizza was the perfect size to share between the two of us. The service was great!! I'll be happy to stop back in and try some of their other menu items

I had a fun family lunch here yesterday, and will definitely be back. We were greeted warmly and asked to sit wherever we'd like. Our waiter came by immediately to take our drink order and bring our menus. I took a minute to check out my surroundings, and found LPK to be clean, brightly lit, and it has a laid back vibe. I split a pizza with my honey, my daughter ordered a Caesar salad wrap, and ditto for her friend. Our wait was brief, and then the goodness arrived. Our pizza was delicious! Every component of this pie impressed my husband and me. The girls' enjoyed their wraps but couldn't get close to finishing them. They were huge and tasty. This was my first visit, and it certainly won...

A friend of mine recommended this place, as I love pizza and trying new places. This was a home run in my opinion. I was told to try the Thunderbird, and it lives up to its name. Fantastic. I loved the deep dish. It's hard to find a place that does a decent one. I can't wait to try other pizzas at this place. I will definitely be back.
